# Dr. Gabe Ariciu, DC — Functional Medicine and Applied Kinesiology

> Solo functional medicine and applied kinesiology practice in Springfield,
> Missouri. Dr. Gabe Ariciu, DC combines functional lab testing with manual
> muscle testing (Systems Health Care) to identify root causes behind chronic
> symptoms, with unhurried one-on-one visits and full doctor access.

## Practice facts

- **Practitioner:** Dr. Gabe Ariciu, DC — licensed Chiropractic Physician,
  State of Missouri. Not a licensed Medical Doctor (MD).
- **Address:** 1736 E. Sunshine St. STE 703, Springfield, MO 65804
- **Phone:** (479) 310-6745
- **Email:** doc@drariciu.com
- **Booking:** https://drariciu.janeapp.com
- **Model:** Solo practitioner, one-on-one care, full doctor access between
  visits. Not a multi-practitioner clinic.
- **Training:** 1000+ postgraduate hours in nutrition and functional medicine.

## Conditions and focus areas

- **Gut health:** SIBO (small intestinal bacterial overgrowth), IBS, leaky gut
  / intestinal permeability, dysbiosis, bloating, constipation, diarrhea,
  indigestion and heartburn
- **Thyroid:** hypothyroidism, Hashimoto's thyroiditis, autoimmune thyroid
  disease, fatigue, cold intolerance, hair loss, weight gain
- **Hormones:** estrogen dominance, PMS, menopausal symptoms, adrenal
  dysfunction, low libido, infertility, night sweats
- **Autoimmune conditions** and chronic inflammation
- **Headaches and migraines**, cervicogenic and tension headaches
- **Chronic fatigue**, brain fog, mitochondrial and neuroimmune involvement
- **Mental health:** anxiety and depression with a root-cause, nutritional lens
- **Chronic infections:** Lyme disease, H. pylori, mold and biofilms
- **Sports injuries and musculoskeletal pain**, fascia and structural care
- **Metabolic health:** insulin resistance, blood sugar regulation

## Methods

- Comprehensive health history and exam
- **Systems Health Care** — a manual muscle testing / applied kinesiology
  technique used to identify and prioritize treatment, accounting for the
  interdependency of the whole body
- **Functional blood work analysis** — interpreting standard labs against
  functional (not just pathological) reference ranges
- **Specialty lab testing** — ordered as needed
- Nutrition and dietary protocols, targeted supplementation
- Myofascial and structural care
